ctx.x: but Chu received severe head injuries and he died four days later without regaining consciousness.))

CC: That's right, and what happened that night, well they were in the car with Lamar Wright, Vernon Brown and Chu, and of course all of us were at the bus and we had to wait until the band boy loaded the bus, so we were half hour behind. So Cab, that Christmas Cab would always buy the band a nice jacket or give us a watch or something like that. Well he bought us all green jackets for Christmas, they were just beautiful. So the majority of the guys in the band had their jackets on that night. So anyway, after the…
projected way up, we happened to see this green jacket....
